purpose: Executable verification contract for the active unit.
passCriteria: Failures are recorded as recovery, not success.
The active unit has an exact-candidate adjudication receipt matching its risk route.
failClosed: If argv, a protected-base content-bound trusted verifier, a command result, or its parser is missing or ambiguous, status MUST be RECOVERY_REQUIRED — never passed.

machineGateTrust.trustedVerifierPolicy: Every commands[].trustedVerifierPaths entry must resolve to identical regular Git objects in protected base and candidate before any command may run; each command binds its exact executable verifier plus every verifier-side file it reads or executes.
machineGateTrust.interpreterIsolation: Python verifiers use -I (or the protected itd_py.sh --itd-isolated mode), excluding the verifier script directory, candidate working directory, user site packages, and candidate-only startup modules such as sitecustomize.py from import resolution.
machineGateTrust.subjectUnderTestBoundary: Candidate implementation/configuration/artifact paths explicitly loaded or read by a protected verifier are subjects under test, not verifier authority. They may differ and remain exact-candidate-bound; any test-side helper that participates in deciding pass/fail belongs in trustedVerifierPaths.
machineGateTrust.rotation: Add a verifier under a new path and merge it, update this protected contract to trust that already-protected path in a second merge, then use it for implementation changes; a PR may not replace the verifier that attests itself.

skillDoneSignalSchema.purpose: Machine-readable Definition-of-Done for the verify/impl skills (v1.60.0 — Ось 2). A skill's DoD must be expressed as >=1 structured done-signal below, not only prose Self-validation — so 'done' is a check, not a vibe. verify_dod_coverage.py enforces coverage of the required set and cross-checks every sentinel ref against the skill that writes it.
